messages:
Ana P (partnerships): Heads-up: vendor roadmap sync tomorrow 10am PT. Main goals: align announcement windows, confirm SKU naming for marketplace, and lock SI onboarding dates. Post any pre-meeting asks or known risks.
Ravi K (Tenstella): Tenstella update: Gaudi silicon availability estimate moved up to 2025-10-01 for initial dev boards. Will confirm mass SKU ETA by next Tue. PR contact is press@tenstella.com.
Sam R (eng-infra): From infra: MI300 driver bundle scheduled for 2025-09-22 drop. We'll need the signed image + checksums to run our perf certs. H200 kernel compat patchset ready but not yet validated on our CI fleet.
Jess M (product): Product note: if Gaudi lands 2025-10-01, we can do internal canary 2025-10-15 and public marketplace listing 2025-11-03. We need vendor sign-off for embargo window.
Marco D (platform): Platform needs an AMI build + docker manifest for Gaudi and MI300. Also request: a short runbook snippet for known device quirks (power limits, driver flags).
Nisha L (sales): Sales ask: can we get SKU mapping to our pricing tiers? Need to prep sales decks and partner co-sell materials before embargo lifts.
Ravi K (Tenstella): We can provide AMI + manifest by 2025-09-25 if tests pass. Runbook quirks doc I can share as early draft by 2025-09-24.
Sam R (eng-infra): Risk: B200 firmware still in vendor beta. If it doesn't clear, we should call it "beta" in the marketplace and not include it in the GA announcement. Also we need to decide fallback models for low-latency SLOs.
Ana P (partnerships): Proposal: split announcement into two waves: Wave A (GA): H100, H200, MI300. Wave B (beta/preview): B200, Gaudi (preview) if artifacts lag. Thoughts?
Jess M (product): +1. Two-wave reduces blast radius. We'll prepare separate release notes and acceptance criteria per wave.
Marco D (platform): Implementation note: I'll add marketplace feature flags: sku_wave: "A" or "B" and compat_flags per vendor. Quick snippet for ops:
```
{
  "sku": "redwood-gaudi-1x",
  "vendor": "Tenstella",
  "wave": "B",
  "compat_flags": ["kern_v1","kv_cache_opt"]
}
```
Sam R (eng-infra): I'll open PR for the config toggle and a gating job in CI that fails if B200 firmware checksum isn't present.
Ravi K (Tenstella): For embargo: Tenstella prefers 2025-11-01 public window but can be flexible +/- one week. Need final copy of partner blurb and logos 72 hours before.
Ana P (partnerships): Action items:
- Ravi: deliver AMI/manifest + runbook draft (due 2025-09-25)
- Sam: PR for feature-flag gating + CI gate for B200 (due 2025-09-26)
- Marco: add sku_wave toggle and staging rollout plan (due 2025-09-27)
- Jess: prepare two release note drafts and acceptance criteria (due 2025-09-28)
- Nisha: draft sales co-sell template and pricing map (due 2025-09-29)
Ana P (partnerships): I'll coordinate embargo negotiation with NVIDIA/Tenstella and produce the consolidated timeline doc before the sync.
QA-bot: Reminder set: vendor roadmap sync 1: 2025-09-08 10:00:00 PT (auto-reminder 15m).
Ravi K (Tenstella): Noted. I'll share initial artifacts to the upload link once CI signs off. Thanks everyone.
